title: Purgreate
description: Yet another Vanilla+ modpack featuring Create and some of it's addons.
body:
***

![purgreate](https://github.com/ItsWiley/NirvanaBV/blob/main/branding/banner-create.png?raw=true) Purgreate implements the Create mod along with additional addons to faciliate gameplay on multiplayer servers and survival single player worlds, while not straying too far from a "normal" Minecraft experience that anyone can sit-down, learn, and play.

***

*   **Content Mods**
    *   **_Create_** - A tech mod focused on automation and large-scale contraptions using rotational power and kinetic energy.
    *   **_Create Aeronautics_** - Introduces the ability to build fully functional, physics-based airships and flying machines.
    *   **_Create: Enchantment Industry_** - Integrates enchantment mechanics into Create, allowing for automated experience handling and liquid XP.
    *   **_Create Propulsion: Simulated_** - Introduces powerful engines and propulsion systems for advanced flying contraptions.
    *   **_Create: Hypertubes_** - High-speed player transportation tubes powered by Create kinetic energy.
    *   **_Create Jetpack_** - Introduces a jetpack that utilizes Create's energy system to power flight.
    *   **_Create Railways Navigator_** - Enhances the Create Railways experience with improved connections between stations and train control.
    *   **_Create: Copycats+_** - Expands on the copycat block mechanic, allowing more blocks to take on the appearance of others.
    *   **_Create: Interiors_** - Adds a variety of decorative blocks specifically designed for furnishing Create-based builds and vehicles.
    *   **_Create Deco_** - Adds a massive selection of industrial-themed decorative blocks and props.
    *   **_Create Bells & Whistles_** - Adds 36 new decorative and utility blocks relating to the Create mod.
    *   **_Create Escalated_** - Introduces escalator-like transportation using Create mechanics.
    *   **_Farmers Delight_** (with **_Create Slice & Dice_**) - A culinary mod that expands farming and cooking with new crops, recipes, and food preparations.
*   **Structure & Generation Mods**
    *   **_Terralith_** - Replaces the default overworld generation with stunning, complex terrain using only vanilla blocks.
    *   **_Create Rustic Structures_** - Generates new structures in the world that are built with Create blocks and have a rustic aesthetic.
    *   **_YUNG's Better Generation Suite_** - Completely overhauls vanilla structures like Strongholds, Temples, Nether Fortresses, and Dungeons to be more rewarding and expansive.
*   **Extras**
    *   **_Appleskin_** - Displays food saturation and hunger values directly on the HUD, helping players manage their hunger more effectively.
    *   **_Sodium & Lithium Performance Suite_** - A collection of industry-standard optimization mods designed to improve Minecraft's performance and reduce lag.
    *   **_You're in Grave Danger_** - Adds a grave system to recover your items safely after death.
    *   **_Nature's Compass_** - A utility tool that allows you to search for and locate specific biomes in the world.
    *   **_Jade_** - Provides detailed information about blocks and entities in the world simply by looking at them.
    *   **_Just Enough Items_** - An essential utility mod that allows players to view all items and their crafting recipes in-game.
    *   **_Just Zoom_** - Adds a simple zoom function, allowing players to get a closer look at distant objects.
    *   **_Lootr_** - Ensures that every player receives their own unique loot from chests, preventing loot competition on servers.
    *   **_Rechiseled_** (with **_Rechiseled Create_**) - Adds many new decorative block variations for existing materials, allowing for more detailed building.
    *   **_Xaero's Minimap & Worldmap_** (with **_Xaero Train Map_**) - Provides real-time navigation and waypoints, with added support for viewing Create train tracks on your map.

***
